chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from an-Nadr ibn Suwayd from 'Asim ibn Humayd from Muhammad ibn Qays from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
Regarding a woman who died and no one was known to be related to her, and she had a husband, he said: 'The inheritance is for her husband.'
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a husband when his wife dies with no other known relatives?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Baqir (AS), the husband is designated as the sole heir of a wife who dies without known ascendants, descendants, or siblings, highlighting the principle of 'Ashab al-Furud' taking precedence when no 'Asabah' (residuary heirs) exist. This ruling underscores the husband's unique position in Shia inheritance jurisprudence, where he inherits the entire estate in the absence of other kin, reflecting the Quranic structure of fixed shares and residual entitlements.
